items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had the opportunity to see Michelle in concert and even on the panel discussion, and I said, that’s beautiful, that they are following in the footsteps of their dad.

ctx.x: I say that because I just look at you as a family man. I look at – one time, you were over at Kate’s. There’s Aria outside. She’s furiously trying to learn this song. It seems like you gave it to her this afternoon. I think the show was going to happen in short order. She was out there, really working. I had the opportunity to see Michelle in concert and even on the panel discussion, and I said, that’s beautiful, that they are following in the footsteps of their dad. I’ve seen you and Mrs. Hendricks in…

It is a family, absolutely. That’s the way we treat it. Everybody comes to rehearsal gets fed, because it gets to be time to eat. So everybody eats. We do everything like a family, because I think that’s the normal way to work. We’re now screening girls to replace the guy that’s working in our office who’s moving to Seattle. We’ve already interviewed four very, very competent ladies. They all said, when they got back to the agency, that they’ve never seen a better office than that, because it’s so warm. The…
